text:
Power Station
Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection checklist I1, to be performed 
on an annually bases
as indicated by Y1 in the title block 
The following specification:
- Control system : MARK II
-
Total shipped : 1825
-
Sequencing : Discrete solid state components 
-
Control : Integrated circuits
-
Protection : Relays & solid state
-
Display : Analog and digital meter ; solid state annunciator
-
Input : Push buttons and bat handle switches
-
Fault Tolerance : Manually rejectable failed exhaust thermocouples
The first draft initiated by eng. Adel Abd 
El-Aziz, tested by eng. Abdel Meniem Ibrahem Haykial at 06 June 2003, revised by EDEPCo quality control eng. Abd El-Monem El-Emam, accepted by general 
director eng. 
Abdel Meniem Ibrahem Haikal and approved by eng. Mostafa Allam 
head sector of Talkha power plant.
The first draft is updated by eng. Wagdy Eid Mansour , tested by eng. Abdel Meniem Ibrahem Haikal 
at date 11/02/09 ,reviewed by
EDEPCo quality control eng. Adel 
elNagar , Accepted by general director eng. Mamdouh El-saeid Anber ,and approved 
by eng.Farouk awad head sector of Talkha Power Plant .
Safety Precautions
Work order must be issued
Wear your safety helmet, shoes ... etc
Don't use an ultrasonic cleaner
Don't use compressed air
Tools and Equipment
Suitable tool set, spray contact cleaner
Digital voltmeter
Dry air blower, brushes
Work to be Carried Out
Any indication of corrosion or discoloration at Speed tronic frame, due to heat, should be 
 investigated and the equipment repaired or replaced as necessary.
The relative humidity of the speed tronic control page location should be 
 maintained at 50% or less to minimize any possible corrosion problems.
First clean by dry natural air to remove dust
Clean the board by use of detergent solution such as video spray with the aid 
 of bristled brush
Visually inspect the board for cleanliness and repeat step 3, if necessary
